license.notes: Interior species (Zoo 0.84.0), the basement and utility-room anchor. REFERENCE: a 1990s upflow gas furnace (almond sheet-metal cabinet, blower and louvred burner doors, galvanised supply plenum and trunk, inducer and 4-inch flue, black-iron gas line with drip leg and shut-off, return-air drop) and a 40-gallon gas water heater (faceted tank, domed top, burner cover and gas control valve, EnergyGuide sticker, relief valve and discharge pipe, copper lines, draft hood and flue). Both stand on a concrete pad that is the slot's footprint and run the flue to the slot's top, so the volume should be authored to the ceiling. Geometry planned purely in core/furnace_forms.py. BUILT (0.84.0): furnace 532 tris at 0.9 x 1.0 x 2.4 and 1.2 x 1.2 x 3.0; water heater 596 at 0.6 x 0.6 x 2.4 and 0.5 x 0.5 x 1.4. BUDGET 1200: one per basement or utility room, so twice the measured size leaves room for the return-air drop and a longer gas line without a second look.
